_meta.note: JSON has no comment syntax, so this _meta block documents intent inline. This entire file is ignored by rulesHash computation except the exact fields listed per-milestone under `rulesHashFields` — see rulesEngine.js's computeRulesHash().
_meta.rulesHashScheme: keccak256(utf8Bytes(canonicalString)) where canonicalString is the pipe-delimited format already committed on-chain by contracts/script/Deploy.s.sol for the demo milestone. This file's milestone id 2 fields were chosen to reproduce that exact string byte-for-byte — do not edit milestone 2's contractId/expectedItem/expectedQty/unit/unitPriceUSD/tolerances without also updating Deploy.s.sol, or verifyAndAdvance() will revert with RulesHashMismatch.
